title: Ziusudra/Utnapishtim's ark lands in the Ararat region
place_text: Shuruppak, Iraq to Mount Ararat, Armenia/Turkey

tellings.quote: Landing in the Mount Ararat region okay of uh Armenia turkey area

plain: In the ancient flood story, the boat built by the flood hero, called Ziusudra in one version and Utnapishtim in another, set out from the old city of Shuruppak in what is now Iraq and came to rest in the region of Mount Ararat, in the Armenia and Turkey area. A researcher named Matt LaCroix sums this up from two ancient Mesopotamian poems, the Atrahasis and the Epic of Gilgamesh, without quoting a particular source, as part of his case that something huge happened to the world around 12,000 BC.
